question: Can direct actual-CIELAB construction combine the frozen monotone characteristic L-star coordinate with CB32 chroma while hue-preserving gamut compression maintains exact order, safety and visible style?

population.role: direct-Lab mechanism development on the exact P8BN ordinary-photo population; decoded SHA disjoint from CB45

operator.lightness: exact CB11 anchored monotone characteristic applied to actual source CIELAB L-star
operator.chroma: global dose interpolation from source CIELAB a/b toward unchanged CB32 target a/b
operator.gamut: 24-step binary chroma contraction from neutral at fixed target L-star and hue into linear-sRGB
operator.primary_near_neighbor: Tajbakhsh and Mirzaei, Computationally-efficient Hue-preserving Gamut Mapping in RGB and YUV, Electronic Imaging 2025, DOI 10.2352/EI.2025.37.10.IPAS-226
operator.forbidden: per-pixel repair, RGB residual rebase, local mask, learned final RGB, changed target, adaptive dose grid or post-result threshold

stop_rules: Any exact order, gradient, boundary, style, dose or gamut-retention failure closes before visual review.
A severe or blind failure closes without changing the population, Lab space, characteristic curve, target, grid or thresholds.
A pass opens only a separately frozen source-disjoint confirmation.
claim_ceiling: Development-only direct-CIELAB Look Approximation evidence on a previously consumed ordinary-photo population; not independent confirmation, novelty claim, stock response, calibration, population preference or product promotion.
